title: Counting algorithm state
statement: A state is a tuple of natural numbers recording the input length $n$, halving count $lg$, add-twice counter $k$, window radius $s$, exponent $e$ and code bound $K$, doubling scratch register $T$, stage $i$ and stage-plus-one $i1$, known-ball size $cp$, outer vertex $v$ and next-ball count $c$, inner vertex $u$ and inner count $cnt$, guessed code $g$, current walk code $cur$, and walk step count $stp$.
